title: Chiropractic Office & Wellness Clinic Sanitation Guide
heroTitle: Chiropractic Office & Wellness Clinic Sanitation Standards
heroSubtitle: Vinyl-safe table disinfection, HIPAA privacy compliance, and indoor air quality standards for chiropractic directors.
metaDescription: Guide to chiropractic clinic cleaning, neutral pH vinyl-safe adjustment table disinfection, HIPAA privacy compliance, and low-VOC air quality.

sections.title: Protecting Adjustment Tables & Patient Hygiene
sections.content: Chiropractic clinics feature continuous patient contact with adjustment tables and therapy cushions. Cleaning programs must use neutral pH, non-alcohol EPA disinfectants that eliminate pathogens without cracking vinyl or degrading seams.

calloutContent: Ensure your chiropractic practice uses manufacturer-approved table disinfectants and HIPAA-compliant cleaning protocols.

faqs.question: Do your cleaning crews sign a HIPAA BAA?
faqs.answer: Yes. All crews assigned to chiropractic and outpatient medical facilities operate under executed HIPAA Business Associate Agreements.
